text_block_list.text:
An incident has occurred! During lunch, 
someone stole Mejiro McQueen's pudding!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why! You can leave this to 
Great Detective Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel nothing but anxiety about this, 
but... I do appreciate your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, first off, the person who discovers 
the body is always the most suspicious, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why me!? Besides, the pudding hasn't even 
been found yet, so I'm not even the 
discoverer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, it's a detective story 
trope! So, what's your alibi?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... even if you ask for an alibi, I was 
really just having lunch...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So the pudding was still there back then, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I left the lid slightly open so 
everyone would know it was mine...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The lid...!? Did you open it halfway or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes... But how did you know that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I—I—It just clicked! A stroke of genius!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The culprit of this baffling case is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This is the work of Great Phantom Thief 
Golshi the Third, formerly known as the 
Great Detective!

In that instant, Gold Ship dashed away 
from the scene with speed unlike anything 
I had ever seen before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a second, Gold Ship!! Wait, didn't 
you just get faster at running away!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm a master phantom thief, of course I'm 
fast at making a getaway!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...! I am definitely going to catch 
you, just you waaaait!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Fuhahahaaa!! Farewell, McQueen!!

From this day on, the sharpness of Gold 
Ship's running improved drastically, 
though few knew the reason why...
